question: Should Crabbox accept the full External desktop contract in this PR, including the 18-file bearer portal-viewer bootstrap, or require a narrower External macOS credential change first?
rationale: The branch is technically hardened but adds substantial configuration, persisted routing, credential, and portal-authentication surface; automation cannot decide whether that breadth is the intended product contract.

options.title: Narrow, refresh, and prove
options.body: Split the bearer-viewer bootstrap unless strictly required, refresh against main, and require exact-head External macOS create/use/reset/destroy proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the full contract
options.body: Keep the complete branch but require explicit compatibility acceptance and real External macOS lifecycle proof on the refreshed head.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave External desktop credentials out of core until a supported macOS endpoint and a smaller permanent contract are available.

recommendation.title: Narrow, refresh, and prove
recommendation.body: Split the bearer-viewer bootstrap unless strictly required, refresh against main, and require exact-head External macOS create/use/reset/destroy proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent merged credential and macOS portal history and performed the branch's security and integration hardening.
